planted_path_control.note_fp_isogeny_preserves_special_detect: F_p-rational isogenies preserve #E and N*; anomalous/MOV detectors are class invariants. FIX-3 therefore requires the recovered reverse path to be at distance >= 1 (min_hops=1) with a non-empty edge path and endpoint != search start; the depth-0 self-hit is not a recovery. The discrete-log certificate is wrapper-reverified (harness ToyEC.mul) on the planted endpoint instance (toy pullback = direct solve; no isogeny evaluation at toy scale).
